ActionCombat: enemy moves that land the blows they choose, and attacks with a shape (MythRunner FG-31: "a goblin with a dagger that attacks us should hit in most cases").

New module `ActionCombat` (MythRunner request): real-time action combat where contact decides the hit.

`TurnPrompt.Title`: what to ask the players, from `TurnHost.OpenPrompt(..., title:)` (The Bloodline Hunt).
`MusicTrack.Loop` (on by default): off plays the track once, for stingers (MythRunner).

`IStatusEffectManager` has `ApplyEffect(entity, effect, source, time, power, duration)` and `IStatusEffectInstance` has `Power`; `IActorWorld` has `IsPaused` (a game that implements them itself adds them). `PartyStatus` carries `Paused`.

`IActorWorld` has `Interactions`, `NearestInteraction` and `Interact` (a game that implements it itself adds them). `CoopWorldMessage` carries places (`Places`, `PlacesGone`, change `Interacted`), `CoopIntentMessage` has `Interact` and `PointId`.

Ability range is checked in kit games. `ActionRpgHost` never set `ActionRpgModule.Distance`, so `Range` on an ability was ignored. Now `ActionRpgHost.AbilityDistance(caster, target)` measures it (scene distance by default; a runner or grid game overrides it with its own measure).
